claim_boundary: GO, if present, proves exact native-human path provenance, deterministic counterfactual pairing, projection, separation, phase/timing registration, and same-camera static-environment depth clearance only. It does not prove replacement-human pixels, body intersection/contact, acoustics, or formal Episode eligibility.

depth_authority.environment_depth_reconstruction: per-pixel median of normal depth over frames where neither old source1 nor old source2 target-only footprint covers the pixel

counterfactual_pairing.claim_boundary: Both roots/phases are native-human-derived, but the people did not co-occur natively. Pairing and depth safety are CPU-derived and replacement-human pixels remain pending.
counterfactual_pairing.time_registration: each minimum-threshold native polyline is independently equal-arc sampled to the shared f0-f74/15Hz timeline; each native gait phase is independently unwrapped and interpolated by accumulated arc

selection_policy: first pre-ranked geometry candidate passing both exact depth corridors
